target_customer: Software engineering and security teams at tech, fintech and web3 companies and open source projects
problem: Rule based static analysis tools produce noisy findings and miss business logic bugs; security teams drown in false positives.
business_model: B2B SaaS AI-native application security platform (SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, autofix)

founders.name: Dean Valentine
previous_startups: Mevlink (co-founder, acquired by bloXroute Labs in 2023)
founders.background_notes: Holds OSCP and OSCE per Zeltser profile; education not found.

education: Brown University, MS Cybersecurity and Policy
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him under former founders while his title is CTO.

education: University of Southern California, Economics (leave of absence)

founders.name: Nathan Hrncirik
education: University of Texas at San Antonio, BS
founders.background_notes: Listed as co-founder by Zeltser profile and the team page; YC page names him in the launch post only.

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM-driven vulnerability detection with validation and autofix needs strong security expertise; founders had Google and Bishop Fox backgrounds.

defensibility.rationale: Quality depends on prompting and validation pipelines that rivals such as Corgea and incumbents can replicate; benchmark claims are vendor stated.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents added AI features (Semgrep Multimodal, Snyk Code) but ZeroPath still gained named customers and curl and RSAC 2026 Innovation Sandbox recognition.

market_need_then: Noisy SAST output was a known pain; ZeroPath later claimed about 90 percent noise reduction (company claim) and found about 170 valid curl bugs per its own blog.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical, benchmark and research driven, tagline Agentic AppSec for Everyone

branding.brand_signature: Public bug finds in curl and other open source projects
branding.community_and_virality: curl maintainers list ZeroPath among AI analyzers; independent tester Joshua Rogers ranked it top three of AI SAST tools

brand_strength.rationale: Research credibility and RSAC 2026 Innovation Sandbox finalist status help; name itself generic.

outcome_analysis: ZeroPath is active. It launched publicly with a seed led by SurgePoint in January 2025 and has grown through research credibility such as curl bug finds and an RSAC 2026 Innovation Sandbox slot. Founders have security depth and a prior exit. Competition from Snyk, Semgrep and other AI SAST startups is intense, and seed size is unverified.
notes: Seed amount undisclosed in the company release; secondary figures conflict ($2M CB Insights, $5M to $7M Zeltser, $12.5M careers page, $20M SignalBase, $21M StartupHub) and none is recorded. The ACCESS Newswire release returned 403 on fetch; its content is taken from search summaries and fintech.global. The $500K YC amount comes from Zeltser only. A $5M SAFE from Crosspoint Capital for RSAC 2026 finalists was noted by Zeltser and not recorded. Competitor source_date null because incumbents are cited from a 2026 profile. Competition list left empty because no source dated near mid 2024 was found; Semgrep, Snyk, Checkmarx, Corgea and Arnica appear only in 2025 to 2026 sources.
